(define (hex-label n) (string-append "0x" (number->string n 16)))
(define (num->str n)
  (if (= 1 (denominator n))
      (number->string (numerator n))
      (string-append (number->string (numerator n)) "/" (number->string (denominator n)))))
(display (list 'hex (hex-label 255) 'BUG (number->string 1/3) 'safe (num->str 1/3)))

(define (perfect-square? n) (= 0 (cadr (pair n))))

               'unpacked (pair 17)

(define (simplest-pair x tol)
  (let ((fx (exact->inexact x)) (ft (exact->inexact tol)))
    (let loop ((d 1))
      (if (> d 64) (list 'none)
          (let ((n (round (* fx d))))
            (if (<= (abs (- (/ n d) fx)) ft) (list n d) (loop (+ d 1))))))))
(display (list 'x3/10 (simplest-pair 3/10 1/10) 'motoi (rationalize 3/10 1/10)
               'x1/7 (simplest-pair 1/7 1/2) 'motoi (rationalize 1/7 1/2)))
